subject: Onsite workshop — attendee split payments and corporate card exception
messages:
From: Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@aldertech.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: AlderTech Procurement <procurement@aldertech.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — attendee split payments and corporate card exception

Hi Jasmine / Laura,

Thanks again for hosting the AlderTech enterprise workshop the week of 11/15. A couple of billing complications came up on our end and I wanted to check options so we can lock rooms and travel this week: 

- We need the lodging charges for 6 attendees invoiced to AlderTech procurement (procurement@aldertech.com) rather than charged to Redwood's corporate card. Our AP requires a PO for hotel invoices.
- The corporate card Redwood provided for incidentals hit the single-transaction limit when the lead attendee tried to guarantee the room. Could you confirm whether you can request a temporary limit increase for one merchant charge, or whether DeltaCorp can accept a mixed payment (invoice for room + card for incidentals)?
- We attached an updated attendee itinerary and the preferred billing contact. If you need exact amounts to request an exception, let us know — we can provide an internal PO within 48 hours.

Attached: itinerary_AlderTech_v2.pdf

Appreciate a quick turnaround so we don't lose the group rate.

Best,
Samantha Greene
Program Manager, Events
AlderTech
procurement@aldertech.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@aldertech.com>, DeltaCorp Travel <bookings@deltacorptravel.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — attendee split payments and corporate card exception

Samantha — thanks for the heads up and the itinerary. We can do either: temporary single-transaction card limit bump for the guarantee, or have DeltaCorp invoice AlderTech for the room and use our card for incidentals only.

A few quick asks so Vivek/Finance can act:
1) Samantha, can you confirm the exact total hotel guarantee amount for the full room block (estimated) so Vivek can request an approval?
2) If AlderTech prefers an invoice, please provide the PO number and billing address/contact for AP.

DeltaCorp — can you hold the reservation for 48 hours while we sort payment? Also need to know whether the hotel will accept split billing (invoice for room + card for incidentals) and what documentation you need from us.

I attached a CSV export of the recent corporate card transactions that show the limit profile for the card being used (corpcard_txn_export.csv). Vivek — could you tell us whether a 48-72hr emergency limit increase is possible and what approval path looks like?

Thanks all — I want to make sure we don't lose the rooms/rates.

— Jasmine
Senior Program Manager, Events
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@aldertech.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — attendee split payments and corporate card exception

Jasmine / team — short answer: we can support either path but need formal items to proceed.

Option A — temporary card limit increase:
- We need the exact merchant MCC and estimated single-transaction amount.
- Approval required from Finance Director; typical turnaround 24 hours once amounts provided.
- We will log the exception and monitor spend; requires sign-off from Rafael for events.

Option B — invoice to AlderTech:
- We need a PO number and AlderTech billing contact (invoice email) and tax information.
- Our AP will accept a supplier invoice from DeltaCorp and process per standard terms.

If AlderTech will provide a PO before 2026-11-12 we can ask DeltaCorp to convert the booking to an invoice guarantee and avoid the card exception. Otherwise we should proceed with a temporary limit increase to secure rooms and convert to invoice if PO arrives later.

Rafael, please confirm you can approve the temporary increase up to $12,000 for the block if needed.

— Vivek
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: DeltaCorp Travel <bookings@deltacorptravel.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@aldertech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — attendee split payments and corporate card exception

Hi Jasmine / Samantha,

We can accommodate split billing for the group: the hotel will invoice AlderTech for room charges if a PO and billing contact are provided, and accept a card guarantee for incidentals only. To proceed we need:
- AlderTech PO number and billing email (procurement@aldertech.com is fine)
- Hotel tax ID and billing address for the invoice
- Authorization to convert the existing provisional reservation to an invoice guarantee

If AlderTech cannot provide a PO within 48 hours, we recommend the temporary card limit increase to guarantee rooms at current rates; otherwise the hotel will release the block.

Attached: hotel_reservation_stub.txt (reservation id and nightly breakdown)

Regards,
DeltaCorp Travel - Group Desk
bookings@deltacorptravel.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@aldertech.com>, AlderTech Procurement <procurement@aldertech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, DeltaCorp Travel <bookings@deltacorptravel.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — attendee split payments and corporate card exception

Samantha / Procurement — looping AlderTech AP in. Per Vivek and DeltaCorp, the options are:

1) AlderTech sends PO + billing details to DeltaCorp (procurement@aldertech.com -> bookings@deltacorptravel.com). DeltaCorp will convert the reservation to an invoice guarantee and invoice AlderTech for the room block. Attach hotel_reservation_stub.txt and hotel_receipt_11-08.pdf.

2) If PO cannot be provided by 2026-11-12 EOD, Rafael has provisionally agreed to approve a temporary limit increase up to $12,000 to secure the block and we will reverse/convert to invoice if you send PO afterwards. Vivek, please confirm you will process the exception if needed.

Attached: corpcard_txn_export.csv, hotel_receipt_11-08.pdf

Next steps for AlderTech: please confirm which option and, if invoice, send PO + billing address by 11/12 to avoid release of group rates. If you prefer we initiate the temporary limit request now, Rafael please let us know and we will submit.

Thanks — Jasmine
Senior Program Manager, Events
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Greene <samantha.greene@aldertech.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, DeltaCorp Travel <bookings@deltacorptravel.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: AlderTech Procurement <procurement@aldertech.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — attendee split payments and corporate card exception

Jasmine / team — thanks for coordinating. AlderTech will proceed with Option 1: we will raise a PO and send to bookings@deltacorptravel.com by tomorrow morning (11/16). Billing contact is Emma Cross (emma.cross@aldertech.com), billing address included in the PO.

Please hold the block until DeltaCorp confirms receipt of the PO. We appreciate the temporary approval path option if anything slips on our side.

See you all onsite — looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Samantha Greene
Program Manager, Events
AlderTech
